title: Le Creuset Enameled Cast Iron pot – “La Mama” Collection by Enzo Mari
description:
Beautiful enameled cast iron pot by Le Creuset, designed by the renowned designer Enzo Mari for the iconic “La Mama” collection. A timeless and collectible piece known for its functional design and quality craftsmanship.
Made from high-quality cast iron, it offers excellent heat retention and even cooking. The pot features a lovely color and a classic design that looks great both in the kitchen and on the table.
📌 Condition: Good vintage condition. Please refer to the photos, which are part of the description.
As with all my items, this is a vintage piece that carries its own charm, patina, and possibly some signs of age that reflect its history.
Please check the photos carefully, as they show the actual condition of the skillet and form an integral part of the description.
